annotations.title: Submit a machining request for quotation

description: Submits a request for quotation for machining or testing to the client's drawing or specification. The request passes an automated prohibited-use and sanctions screening; if cleared, it is registered for follow-up by an engineer from enquiry@feode.com. The legal entity, its country, a named contact person and the end-use are required. The result is an acknowledgement, not an offer or quotation; no payment is taken.

country.description: Country of registration of the legal entity

drawing_url.description: Address of a drawing or specification (optional)

email.description: E-mail address of the contact person (company domain)

part_description.description: Description of the part or component, or drawing reference
